# Generated corpus

Every certificate, OCSP response and CRL here is TEST-ONLY and generated by OpenSSL, an implementation
independent of ti-pki and go/tipki, from [`generate.sh`](generate.sh); the keys exist only in a temporary
directory while it runs. The OCSP responses are assembled from DER pieces by
`rust/ti-pki/tests/pki/ocsp.sh`, since `openssl ocsp` can neither back-date a response nor add the certHash
extension the TI requires. Everything is valid around 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, the reference time of every
case, so nothing goes stale.

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `ti-*.pem` | a TI component PKI: GEM.RCA90, GEM.KOMP-CA90, its OCSP responder and C.FD.TLS-S, C.ZD.TLS-S and C.FD.TLS-C server certificates, each breaking one rule; the script's header lists them |
| `web-*.pem` | a stand-in Web-PKI: a root, an RSA 2048 CA, a weak RSA 1024 CA, an OCSP responder and server certificates, each breaking one rule |
| `ocsp/*.der` | OCSP responses: `<certificate>-<status>`, `ti-good-stale` (an hour old), `ti-good-wrong-hash` (certHash of another certificate) |
| `crl/*.der` | CRLs of the web CA: none revoked, and `web-crl-revoked` revoked |
| `manifest.json` | the cases, written by [`manifest.py`](manifest.py) |
| `handshake.json` | what a client offers under each profile, by hand |

First generated with OpenSSL 4.1.0 (2026-11-06).
